purpose: Compare a known retrieval problem with a specific remediation. A treatment marked pending requires application work before it can be run; available treatments can be performed with the current application.

experiments.problem: Dense similarity can rank a superseded policy above the current policy because their wording is almost identical.
experiments.query: How many annual leave days does a full-time employee receive in 2026?

control.failure_signal: annual-leave-policy-2024-superseded.md ranks above the current policy or supports a 20-day answer

treatment.configuration: Extract status and effective dates at ingestion, then filter to status=current and effective_date<=2026-12-31 before vector ranking

success_criteria: annual-leave-policy-2026.md is the highest-ranked leave policy
The retrieved evidence states 25 working days
The superseded policy is absent from active-policy results

experiments.problem: Dense embeddings can underweight exact identifiers even when they capture the general topic.

treatment.configuration: Combine MongoDB text-search and vector-search candidates, then fuse their ranks
treatment.semantic_signal: Policy meaning and surrounding security content

success_criteria: The returned passage contains both SEC-104 and Information Security Policy
Semantic paraphrase performance from the baseline suite does not regress

experiments.problem: A generic character splitter can separate CSV rows from their column headings, leaving numeric values without meaning.
experiments.query: For a Customer Support employee in Portugal, what are the probation and notice periods?
experiments.expected_fact: 120 days of probation and 30 days of notice

control.configuration: Serialize the whole CSV and apply the generic 1,000-character splitter
control.failure_signal: The matching passage contains 120 and 30 but no labels identifying which number is probation and which is notice

treatment.configuration: Create one semantic record per CSV row and repeat column names as field labels
treatment.expected_chunk: country: Portugal; employment_group: Customer Support; probation_days: 120; notice_days: 30; benefit_plan: PT-Core

success_criteria: The Portugal Customer Support row ranks first
The retrieved passage preserves the column names and values together
The evidence unambiguously supports both expected numbers

experiments.problem: A topically similar facilities document can compete with the correct travel-rate source.
experiments.query: What is the nightly hotel cap for business travel to Valencia?

control.configuration: Return the top eight vector-search results directly
control.measurement: Record the ranks of regional-travel-rates.csv and office-facilities-guide.md

treatment.configuration: Retrieve 20 vector candidates and use a query-passage reranker before returning the best five

success_criteria: office-facilities-guide.md does not outrank the rate table
The first passage directly contains Valencia and the EUR 145 hotel value

experiments.problem: Keeping an obsolete policy in the active corpus exposes conflicting answers.
experiments.query: How many annual leave days does a full-time employee receive in 2026?

control.configuration: Keep both annual-leave-policy-2024-superseded.md and annual-leave-policy-2026.md in MongoDB
control.measurement: Record whether the obsolete policy appears in the results

treatment.configuration: Use the application delete action to remove annual-leave-policy-2024-superseded.md, including its raw file, chunks, vectors, and metadata

success_criteria: MongoDB contains no chunks for the deleted document ID
experiments.future_automation: Recognize replacements during ingestion, preserve the old file in an archive, and exclude archived versions from the active retrieval index.

experiments.problem: Nearest-neighbor search always returns the closest chunks even when the corpus does not contain an answer.

control.configuration: Always display the top eight vector results
control.failure_signal: The interface presents unrelated passages as though they answer the question

treatment.configuration: Calibrate a minimum relevance threshold on labelled answerable and unanswerable questions, then abstain when no result passes it

success_criteria: The system states that the available documents do not contain an answer
No unsupported dental benefit is inferred
Answerable baseline questions remain above the chosen threshold
